patches.reason: IAD 0 (interfaces 0-2) bFunctionClass 0xFF (vendor) -> 0x01 (Audio). usbaudiod logs AUAErrorCode.missingAssociation and drops the device without an audio-class IAD.

AS_GENERAL (IF1, playback) bmControls 0x05 claims read-only Active Alt Setting + Valid Alt Settings controls. The firmware STALLs those requests (probed on the real unit), and usbaudiod tears the device down after the stalls. 0x00 = no controls claimed, so macOS does not ask.
Same as above for the record stream (IF2, AS_GENERAL).
rate GET_CUR: jmp @r6 (r6 = cave1 via patched literal); nop
range clock 6: r2 = cave3 (patched literal); jmp @r2 (delay slot = 0x0C038F18)
literal used only by 0x0C038F16: range block 0x0C0C3493 -> cave3
selector GET_CUR: r6 = cave2 (inline literal at 0x0C038F54); jmp @r6; nop; nop
caves 1-3 over the lowercase serial-command table (service UART only)

CS isochronous endpoint (playback, EP 0x01) bmControls 0x15 -> 0x14. Bits 0-1 = 01 claim a pitch control. Linux snd-usb-audio takes the pitch bit from here for UAC2, sends SET_CUR 'enable PITCH' to the endpoint, the firmware STALLs it, and the stream cannot be opened (aplay: 'Unable to install hw params'; Akai MPC One: 'Broken pipe -32'). 0x14 keeps the other two (overrun/underrun) fields as they were and drops the pitch claim.
